ui.design_rationale: The requested product detail inventory summary belongs on the existing consumer shopping screen, so the warm commerce palette complements the product-focused content.

files.purpose: Update the existing product detail page to show the sum of variant stock quantities as '<number> total in stock' between the description and variants, only after a product loads.

verify.steps: Open a product with variants and confirm the total of their stock_qty values appears as '<number> total in stock' after the description and before Variants; add the selected variant to the cart and confirm the success feedback appears.

build_log.last_action: Created incremental build contract for the existing ProductPage stock total display.

assumption: The existing catalog endpoint supplies the loaded product's variants including each stock_qty, so the total can be computed locally without changing the service or app shell.
